summary: At 120% feed the vapour load is 272 t/h (120% of K-201 226.8 t/h) and fouled heater needs 9649 m2 (109.6% of 8800 m2) per run vrc_120_scaled. Only clean to 2500 U plus parallel K-202 at 45.4 t/h and 1880 kW shaft reaches 120.1% with heater 87.7% and K-201 at 100% per run alt3_both_120.
request: Do not change K-201’s existing documented rating or any existing limits.* value.  Rework the rejected compressor proposal as a physical plant modification. Keep K-201 and add a parallel compressor K-202 using add_unit. Insert the required splitter and mixer and use reroute changes so the vapour actually divides between K-201 and K-202 and their discharges rejoin before D-201MIX.  Determine the required K-202 capacity and flow split through simulator runs; do not assume them as final design values. Give K-202 its own preliminary limits and set rating_source to “preliminary selection; vendor quote and compressor curve to confirm”. Report its simulated shaft power, but do not invent a motor nameplate.  After first resolving every blocking model-review finding, re-solve these alternatives in DWSIM at the 120% target:  1. Clean E-201 only 2. Add parallel K-202 only 3. Clean E-201 and add parallel K-202 together  For each alternative, report: - maximum achievable throughput - K-201 and K-202 suction flow and utilisation - compressor shaft power - E-201 required area and utilisation - first remaining bottleneck - whether 120% is achieved  Do not represent a physical modification by increasing K-201’s existing limit. If the required equipment or routing cannot be expressed in the process spec, call report_gap instead of approximating it.
